claims.claim: You need a benefit award letter as evidence for help with fees.
claims.quote: We will contact the Department for Work and Pensions to confirm that you are (or were) getting one of these benefits. We may also contact you if we need to see additional evidence.
claims.note: The text says the court checks benefits with DWP and may ask for more evidence, but does not name a benefit award letter as required.

claims.claim: You need bank statements showing your savings.
claims.quote: This may include bank statements, payslips or letters from Jobcentre Plus.
claims.note: Bank statements are mentioned only as possible evidence of income when the court asks, not as proof of savings.

claims.claim: You need proof of income if you are not on a qualifying benefit.
claims.quote: You do not need to send any evidence of your income unless you get a letter asking for it.
claims.note: Income evidence is needed only if the court sends a letter asking for it; the text does not tie this to not being on a qualifying benefit.
